title: Three Girls Standing Outdoors, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot featuring three young girls standing side-by-side on a paved driveway or pathway. They are dressed in typical 1950s children's attire, including a striped dress, a high-waisted plaid skirt with a wide belt, and a floral patterned skirt. Lush trees and a building are visible in the background under bright sunshine.
